population.justification: same long-term cavity-nesting bird study system; pied flycatcher and great tit are monitored in the same breeding population
population.exclusion_reason: caterpillar biomass peak is unavailable/anomalous in the published resource series; no imputation

migrant_timing.primary_variable: annual female nest-building onset as the source-defined proxy for female arrival at Hoge Veluwe
migrant_timing.secondary_variable: calculated male arrival date; secondary lane only, never substituted into the primary lane after seeing outcomes

resident_partner_timing.primary_variable: annual unweighted mean laying date of included first great-tit clutches

destination_resource_state.primary_variable: annual observed peak date of caterpillar biomass

precommitment_cue.source: NCEP/NCAR or source-faithful equivalent used by the already frozen CV24C cue reconstruction
precommitment_cue.primary_variable: Ivory Coast temperature, fixed 20-day mean beginning 18 February
precommitment_cue.spatial_rule: reuse the frozen 3x3 coarse-grid Ivory Coast proxy from PAYOFF_B_CV24C_CUE_DRIVER_RESULT_20260927; extend identically through 2015 using the same NCEP/NCAR source and transform

cue_resource_predictive_connectivity.processing: within each trailing window ending at t-1, separately linear-detrend cue and resource peak on year, then calculate signed Pearson rho

focal_partner_coordination.partner: annual mean first-clutch great-tit laying date
focal_partner_coordination.primary: signed calendar-day difference focal minus partner
focal_partner_coordination.note: a fixed stage offset does not affect branch contrasts; no post-hoc standardization or stage shifting is allowed

information_reversal_gate.algorithm: single interior breakpoint minimizing segmented linear SSE
information_reversal_gate.pass_rule: segmented AICc <= linear AICc - 4; pre-break slope < 0; post-break slope > 0; post-break endpoint recovers at least 50% of the pre-break-to-break decline
information_reversal_gate.rule: focal and partner timing are not opened for hysteresis testing if this gate fails

history_test_if_reversal_passes.branch_definition: decline versus recovery branch defined only from the frozen cue-resource connectivity breakpoint
history_test_if_reversal_passes.overlap_support: restrict to the range of predictive-connectivity values observed on both branches
history_test_if_reversal_passes.primary_response: signed pied-flycatcher minus great-tit timing difference
history_test_if_reversal_passes.primary_support: 95% CI for the branch coefficient excludes zero at the mean overlapping connectivity
history_test_if_reversal_passes.secondary_support: report interaction estimate and CI without changing the primary criterion
history_test_if_reversal_passes.interpretation_if_supported: natural path dependence in resident-migrant seasonal coordination conditional on a recovered information coordinate
history_test_if_reversal_passes.interpretation_ceiling: does not identify the exact Nash mechanism, does not identify a natural rescue seed, and does not establish that either species intentionally acquires the declared temperature cue

forbidden_moves: do not choose a different African temperature window from the focal or partner timing outcome
do not use the previously observed 2000/2001 CV24C selection-gradient breakpoint as this network breakpoint
do not use the published circa-2008 flycatcher interval reversal to choose regimes
do not impute the 1991 caterpillar peak
do not substitute male calculated arrival for female nest-building in the primary lane after seeing results
do not choose aggregation rules for great-tit laying date after inspecting mismatch
do not redefine a monotonic or one-way connectivity change as recovery hysteresis
do not promote a failed reversal gate to a history test
do not infer a natural singleton rescue species from this analysis
do not truncate the registered 1985-2015 source overlap after inspecting the cue-resource reversal

relationship_to_prior_negative_lane.distinction: the prior lane tested African cue versus annual selection-gradient driver and had no partner timing; this contract prospectively tests African cue versus breeding-ground resource state and, only after an independent reversal gate, resident-migrant coordination history
relationship_to_prior_negative_lane.anti_retuning_rule: the new resource and partner coordinates were identified from independent published datasets and are frozen before their joined outcome is opened
